command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(id -un)" = ai-core-node; case "$(hostname)" in ai-core-node*) ;; *) echo WRONG_HOST:$(hostname) >&2; exit 71;; esac; OLD=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p MainPID --value); echo OLD_PID=$OLD; systemctl --user restart frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service; sleep 2; systemctl --user is-active frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service; NEW=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p MainPID --value); echo NEW_PID=$NEW; test "$NEW" != "0"; test "$NEW" != "$OLD"; echo EFFECTIVE=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p ExecStart --value); tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/"$NEW"/cmdline; echo; systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service --no-pager -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p ExecMainStatus
